ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher, record the driver's misuse of the "I'm Here" button, and send the driver account for review of cancellation/waiting-fee button abuse.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the three chat messages [F8][F9][F10] are a routine pickup/cancellation exchange — no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; the driver statement [F12] is likewise non-abusive. safety_concern = none.

The fee is the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee, so NS-0 routes the case to NS-1/NS-2 (driver cancelled on a no-show claim). NS-1 requires cumulatively: (i) an "I'm Here" tap, (ii) at the tap moment the driver's GPS within 200 m of the pickup, and (iii) more than 3 minutes of continuous waiting inside that radius after the tap. All three fail: the tap at 22:37:20 was 1000 m from the pickup [F5], the driver's closest approach all trip was 873 m and it never came within 200 m [F1], and time within 200 m after the tap was 0 s [F5]; the platform never recorded an arrival at all [F4]. His stationary 5 minutes at 1000 m [F2] and the 9 minutes from acceptance to cancellation [F3] do not satisfy (ii)/(iii), which must be measured at the pickup point. His own statement that he waited at the pickup [F12] is contradicted by the system GPS/timeline records, which take precedence; the chat at 22:38 has the rider saying no car was there [F9], consistent with the GPS. Under NS-2 the driver's claim therefore fails, the $6.61 must be refunded in full (amount per [F6]), and because he tapped "I'm Here" while GPS placed him outside the pickup radius, flag_account is added (abuse of the cancellation/waiting button). The refund is a voucher per NS-7; no NS-7 time bar applies (dispute filed on the trip).

RD-6 is not triggered: this is not an upheld route-deviation case (RD-2 refund = 0), and the driver's 2 upheld no-show disputes [F17] belong to the account-review action, not to RD-6.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's claim that he pressed 'I'm Here' and waited over 3 minutes at the pickup point is contradicted by the system records: at the tap he was 1000 m away [F5], the closest approach was 873 m [F1], time within 200 m after tap = 0 s [F5], and driver_arrived_at is null [F4]. System records override statements, so NS-1 (ii) and (iii) are not met.
